the_singleton_flaw_this_avoids.statement: the real FP sequence starts pi1 vs {pi0}, a pool of SIZE ONE. That cannot prove historical POOL SAMPLING works -- it only re-proves the single-snapshot seam, which is already verified.
the_singleton_flaw_this_avoids.precedent: the same flaw appeared in D1: a one-opponent pool cannot distinguish a working rotator from a broken one, which is why D3 needed its own preflight.
the_singleton_flaw_this_avoids.the_fix: the FP SMOKE deliberately uses a pool of TWO known-compatible current-stack checkpoints, even though generation 1 of the real run will not.

smoke_pool.why_these: both are current-stack 2v2 G0-V5 policies, and both were verified to load as CustomPPOInferencePolicy through the loadability guard before this gate was frozen

criteria.1_preload: every configured snapshot is asserted loadable BEFORE training begins
criteria.2_subset: every selected opponent checkpoint is in the configured pool
criteria.3_coverage: BOTH checkpoints are actually observed (the criterion a size-1 pool cannot test)
criteria.4_episode_hold: one checkpoint is held for a whole episode; no mid-episode switching
criteria.5_boundaries: selection occurs only at episode boundaries
criteria.6_determinism: same seed reproduces the snapshot-selection sequence exactly; a different seed yields a valid independently-sampled sequence over the pool
criteria.7_no_silent_none: a failed load is a HARD failure, never a degradation to None
criteria.8_provenance: the selected checkpoint id/path is written into episode provenance
criteria.9_learning_and_roundtrip: PPO updates normally, and the resulting learner checkpoint saves, reloads and evaluates

explicitly_NOT_required.tight_uniformity: as with D3_POOL_PREFLIGHT, a short smoke must not be failed for lumpy counts. Criterion 6 (exact sequence reproducibility) is the strong check; realized counts are reported, not gated.

outcome.PASS: FP_SMOKE = PASS; the real FP ladder may run pi1 vs {pi0}, pi2 vs {pi0,pi1}, pi3 vs {pi0,pi1,pi2}
outcome.FAIL: do not run FP generations. Repair the seam and re-run; no FP evidence exists yet, so repair is engineering rather than post-data discretion.

what_this_gate_does_NOT_establish: that historical opponents produce better policies than scripted ones
